title: The Ecom Landing Page That Prints Money (We Tested 47)
description: Most ecom landing pages lose 80% visitors in 10 seconds. Here is the 7-section structure that took our client's ROAS from 1.8x to 4.2x.
body:
# The Ecom Landing Page That Prints Money

We audited 47 ecom landing pages last quarter. All selling between Rs 30L to 2Cr per month. 42 had same problem. Beautiful design. Zero money.

Here is the 7-section structure that took our D2C client from 1.8x ROAS to 4.2x in 21 days.

## Section 1: The 5-Second Test
Visitor should know in 5 seconds what is product, who is it for, why care now.

**Bad:** "Welcome to Glow Organics"

**Good:** "Acne Patches That Hide Pimples in 6 Hours - For Working Women. 17,243 Sold This Month."

If you have a slider in hero, delete it today.

## Section 2: The Pain Agitator
Don't start with ingredients. Start with pain: "Tired of patches that fall off during office hours?" Then say "We made this because we had same problem."

## Section 3: The 15-Second Demo
Replace 500 words with one 15-second silent video - hand opening box, applying, 6 hours later result. Add to cart up 28%.

## Section 4: Social Proof That Is Not Fake
**Bad:** "Love it! - Priya S."

**Good:** "I have oily skin and work in sales. I wear this under makeup. My client didn't notice my pimple. Re-ordering 2nd time - Neha, Mumbai, with photo."

Add 3 reviews with photos, UGC grid, real press only.

## Section 5: The Objection Killer
- "Patch doesn't stick? Full refund, no return needed"
- "Delivered in 48 hours or Rs 100 off"
- "WhatsApp us, we reply in 20 mins"

## Section 6: The Bundle That Increases AOV
Don't say "Combo of 2". Say "Office Survival Kit - 30 patches + cleanser - Rs 200 off + free travel case. 68% choose this." Make bundle pre-selected and name it.

## Section 7: The Sticky CTA
On mobile add sticky bar with price and "Get Mine Today" button.

## Red Team
We cut generic advice like "use high-quality images". No pop-ups, no spin wheels - they drop conversion 12% for paid traffic.

## Structure
1 Hero • 2 Pain • 3 Demo video • 4 Real reviews • 5 Objection killer • 6 Named bundle • 7 Sticky CTA.

**If conversion below 2%, it is not product, it is page flow.**

faq.question: What is a good conversion rate for ecom landing page?
What should be on a high converting Shopify landing page?
faq.answer: 7 sections: hero, pain, demo video, real reviews, objection killer, named bundle, sticky CTA.

faq.question: Why is my ecom landing page not converting?
faq.answer: Hero talks about brand not buyer, fake reviews, sliders and pop-ups, hiding refund info.
